title: Perturbation Theory and the Quantum Rabi-model
summary: In the first part of the paper we study a perturbative model of the Rabi system of Quantum Optics. We are therefore able to describe, through Rellich's theory, an analytic expansion of finite families of eigenvalues, of arbitrary fixed length. In particular, we prove that for finite families of eigenvalues the Braak conjecture holds.
